title: Modulo and Counting
statement: The task counts non-increasing arrays of length n with values in [1, m+2] whose sum of a_i mod a_{i+1} is m, modulo 998244353, for n, m <= 4000 (sums bounded). As a mod b <= a-b, equal iff a < 2b, the sum is at most a_1-a_n <= m+1, so arrays descend from m+2 to 2, each under twice the next, then optional 1s, counted by O(nm) prefix-sum dynamic programming.
